title: Schedule a Consultation

seo.title_tag: Schedule a Consultation | Vaughn Law, PLLC
seo.meta_description: Tell us what you need help with, then send a short request to Vaughn Law on St. Pete Beach.

_about: Consultation flow, native Squarespace: step 1 is a page of seven links, step 2 is one page per situation each with its own Form block, step 3 is the form's post-submit message or redirect. The form on these mockup pages is visible but does not submit; its button opens the confirmation page.
verified: The six situation cards: wording from content/proposed/home.json (situation-picker)
Phone number: the live shared contact block
confirm: Page copy: 'What do you need help with?', 'Step 1 of 2' / 'Step 2 of 2', 'Change', 'Send my request', the seven choice cards (six are the home page situation cards verbatim; 'Something else.' and its line are new)

Disclaimer under every form: "Sending this form does not create an attorney-client relationship. Please don't include confidential details." (new wording; the live site's disclaimer page says the site does not create a lawyer-client relationship)

Contact fields on every form: Name, Phone, Email, 'How should we reach you?' (Call / Email), 'How soon do you need help?' (There's a deadline / In the next month / Just planning ahead), 'Anything else we should know?'; Name and Email and the contact method are marked required
The native Squarespace form block cannot show or hide questions, so each situation has its own page with its own form; the step-2 pages carry no confidential-case fields

slots.title: What do you need help with?
slots.text: Choose the one that fits best. We'll ask only what matters for it.

cards.title: I'm buying or selling a home.
cards.text: We handle the contract, the title and the closing, with a lawyer at the table.

cards.title: I need to change a deed.
cards.text: Adding a spouse, removing a name, or moving a home into a trust, prepared and recorded the right way.

cards.title: I have a problem with a tenant.
cards.text: Notices, leases and evictions, handled start to finish.

cards.title: A parent has died.
cards.text: We explain what probate is, whether you need it, and take it from there.

cards.title: I need a will or a trust.
cards.text: We tell you plainly which one fits and what it involves.

cards.title: I just moved to Florida.
cards.text: Your old plan may not work here. We'll show you what to update first.

cards.title: Something else.
cards.text: Tell us what's going on and we'll point you the right way.
